lines: Thus thousand-fold fire-offering to be done with sesame and rice; at the end full and to be given; then to him by initiation the guru.
l4.sanskrit_cite: iti sāhasriko homaḥ kartavyastilataṇḍulaiḥ ante pūrṇā ca dātavyā tato@smai dīkṣayā guruḥ
